76: External crash exclusion is deliberately unavailable: this release has no trusted host process-tree evidence importer bound to the dead process identity. A crashed owner without an internally recorded joined proof stays held, and reclaim refuses. A future host-bound implementation must record process start identity, join the owned complete process tree, authorize and persist a replay-safe proof, and retain uncertain issued effects. It must not accept an unchecked caller assertion.
